title: Translucent Surface & Particle Overdraw Overhead
fix_rationale: Rendering multiple overlapping translucent surfaces, glass, or volumetric effects is creating high GPU fill-rate overhead.
evidence_template: {timer} took {ms} ms ({share}% of excess time) rendering translucent surfaces.

fixes.text: Enable Separate Translucency Screen Percentage (r.SeparateTranslucencyScreenPercentage 50 to 75).
Reduce multi-layer translucent material overdraw on particles, smoke, and glass meshes.
Disable responsive AA and high-cost refraction on non-essential translucent materials.

verify: Adjust r.SeparateTranslucencyScreenPercentage and verify translucency pass times decrease.
